If it’s allergies, it’s usually from pollen or other allergens and can be helped with antihistamine drops or allergy pills [nei_025_chunk_01]. If it’s pink eye from an infection, it can get better on its own or may need antibiotic drops from a doctor [nei_008_chunk_01].

You said you don’t have discharge, so it’s less likely to be an infection (like pink eye) from an organism, but it’s still possible. If it’s allergies, then it’s probably from something in your home or environment.
